skill.description: Edit selected regions across video frames with the RunComfy CLI. Choose a prompt-driven route for object removal, cleanup, and motion-matched replacements.

security_audit.summary: All 57 static detections are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, documentation links, and prose about the external RunComfy CLI. The skill declares a restricted Bash scope and documents sending user-supplied video input to RunComfy, but the reviewed file contains no executable payload, credential collection, prompt injection, or undisclosed exfiltration intent.

remediation.issue: The Markdown examples trigger command-execution detections.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the Bash scope restricted to runcomfy and state that agents must request confirmation before installation or login.

remediation.issue: The skill sends user-provided video to a third-party service.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for confirmation before uploading sensitive video and clearly name the destination in the execution prompt.

remediation.issue: The CLI token location is documented.
remediation.suggestion: Continue to require restrictive token permissions and do not add instructions that display or copy token files.

content.value_statement: Removing or replacing a video region across frames can cause visual drift and broken motion. This skill selects a suitable RunComfy route and provides focused prompts for consistent edits.
actual_capabilities: Selects Wan 2-7 Edit-Video for prompt-driven region edits.
Suggests Lucy Edit Restyle for identity-stable region-aware changes.
Identifies when frame-stack editing suits a short sequence.
Provides CLI input examples with a source video URL and edit prompt.
Explains when mask-driven ComfyUI workflows are more precise.
Lists relevant CLI exit codes for troubleshooting.
limitations: It does not provide pixel-accurate mask propagation through the CLI.
Long clips can lose temporal consistency during sequential edits.
The output quality depends on the selected model and source video.
It requires a RunComfy account, CLI installation, and a reachable video URL.

use_cases.title: Clean a background distraction
use_cases.description: Remove a passing person, cable, or small object while preserving the rest of a short clip.

use_cases.title: Prepare product footage
use_cases.description: Replace a minor visual element across frames using a focused, brand-aware edit prompt.

use_cases.title: Choose a technical editing path
use_cases.description: Decide whether prompt-driven editing or a mask-based ComfyUI workflow fits the required precision.

prompt_templates.title: Remove a simple object
prompt_templates.prompt: Use video inpainting to remove the cable overhead from my video. Preserve all other content and match the background.

prompt_templates.title: Clean a watermark area
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this video with Wan 2-7. Remove the mark in the bottom-right corner across all frames. Keep motion, color, and framing unchanged.

prompt_templates.title: Replace one object
prompt_templates.prompt: Choose the best RunComfy route to replace the red bag with a plain black bag across this clip. Explain why that route fits and provide one edit prompt.

prompt_templates.title: Assess mask precision
prompt_templates.prompt: I need to remove a moving object with pixel-precise boundaries. Compare the CLI route with a ComfyUI mask propagation workflow and recommend the safer quality option.

output_examples.input: Remove the person walking behind the subject.
output: Edit prompt: Remove the person walking in the background across all frames. Fill with the matching environment. Preserve the subject and camera motion.

output_examples.input: I need exact mask boundaries around a moving logo.
output: Recommendation: Use a ComfyUI mask-driven workflow instead of the CLI route.
Reason: Prompt-driven endpoints do not provide pixel-precise mask propagation.

output_examples.output: The request is retryable because it timed out or received a rate-limit response. Retry after a short delay.

best_practices: Use one focused edit per request to reduce visual drift.
State the target region and preservation requirements clearly.
Use a mask-driven workflow when exact boundaries or temporal control are required.
anti_patterns: Do not combine unrelated removals and replacements in one edit request.
Do not use prompt-driven editing when pixel-accurate masks are required.
Do not upload sensitive video without confirming the external service destination.

faq.question: What does this skill edit?
faq.answer: It guides region edits across video frames, such as removing objects or replacing a described area.

faq.question: Which model is the default?
faq.answer: Wan 2-7 Edit-Video is the default for prompt-driven region edits.

faq.question: Can it use exact masks?
faq.answer: No. Use a dedicated ComfyUI workflow for pixel-precise mask propagation.

faq.question: Does it edit still images?
faq.answer: No. The skill directs single-image work to a separate image inpainting workflow.

faq.question: What input does the CLI example require?
faq.answer: It requires a reachable video URL, a clear edit prompt, and RunComfy CLI authentication.

faq.question: How should I protect private video?
faq.answer: Confirm the upload destination, share only authorized video, and avoid placing credentials in prompts.
